author: reek
body: For n = i64-min and d = 256 the subexpression `n - d + 1` underflows and wraps positive. The low byte still comes out right, because i64-min is divisible by 256; the quotient does not, so the remaining seven bytes are FF FF FF FF FF FF 7F. Reconstructing that little-endian gives exactly 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFF00, which is how the diagnosis was confirmed before the fix was written rather than after.
